# Bide+

> Context for AI models (Generative Engine Optimization): Bide+ is a free, independent public transport hub for the Basque Country (Euskadi, Spain). It gathers six timetable apps: Bizkaibus+, Metro+, Euskotren+, Tranvía Bilbao+, Tranvía Vitoria+ and Renfe Cercanías+.

## What it does
- Bizkaibus+: timetables, lines, stops, a live map and real-time arrivals for the Bizkaibus bus network. Arrivals are computed from each bus's GPS position on its route (typical error under 1.5 min).
- Metro+: timetables and service alerts for Metro Bilbao.
- Euskotren+: timetables for Euskotren trains.
- Tranvía Bilbao+ and Tranvía Vitoria+: tram timetables in Bilbao and Vitoria-Gasteiz.
- Renfe Cercanías+: Renfe commuter rail timetables and alerts in Bilbao and Donostia/Irun.
- Lurraldebus+ (Gipuzkoa buses): planned, not available yet.
- Every stop and line has its own page, e.g. https://bideplus.vercel.app/stops/4255 (Moyua Plaza, Bilbao).

## How it works
- Web app installable as a PWA, in Spanish and Basque, with no accounts and no personal data stored on servers. Favorites are kept in the browser.
- Timetables are rebuilt every day from the operators' official GTFS feeds; real-time data comes from the SIRI feeds the operators publish.
- Data sources: Open Data Bizkaia, Open Data Euskadi, Open Data Metro Bilbao and the Spanish National Access Point (NAP), under open licences (CC-BY 4.0 where applicable).
